name: Hecher Sosa
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: A Spanish bantamweight from Animal Fight Center (14-1, age 31), 1-0 in the UFC after a decision over Luan Lacerda in March; he won a contract on the 2025 Contender Series.

how_they_fight.Striking: Six knockouts in our data (four in R1, two in R3).
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: His last three wins went the distance.

patterns: Goes the distance against good opponents
keys_to_beat: Take him down and hunt the back
